# LimeDock

> LimeDock automates marketing, sales, and management workflows for SaaS teams.
> We design and ship live automations the customer owns — plugged into Slack, CRM, and internal platforms.

## What we sell

Owned workflow automations for SaaS teams — not another prompt library or shared agent account.
Customers keep the code and run durable marketing, sales, and ops workflows in their stack.

## Who it's for

SaaS founders, growth/marketing leaders, sales ops, and product/ops teams who still run critical workflows by hand every week.
